contradictions.detail: Seller comment 3 days ago: 'garage kept its entire life'. Seller comment 11 hours ago: 'I can't guarantee this vehicle was garage kept'.

critical_evidence.evidence: The seller explicitly states the cylinders have not been scoped and no oil analysis has been done. Cold-start video and oil level are not evidence of clean bores.
No DME over-rev report is mentioned.
The seller states he has no records of cooling, clutch, plugs or other major services. Post-2014 independent-shop Carfax entries say only 'vehicle serviced'.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN, build sheet, attached Carfax and AutoCheck, clean PA title, and a candid seller. The maintenance half is thin. There are two oil/tire receipts. There are no cooling, AOS, clutch or plug records, and the last brake flush on record is 2014. There is no borescope or DME report, and no repair documentation for the 2014 moderate-damage accident.

condition.rationale: Disclosed flaws are minor: faulty rain sensor, chips (some touched up), bumperette indentations, seat wear, and worn hood struts per a third party. The open item is the 2014 moderate front/left-side collision with no repair records. The one photo shows a clean car with even gaps, but that is not structural evidence. Engine condition on an M97 3.4 is unproven.

price_value.rationale: The current bid of $12,000 is far below the $28.5–35k fair value, but the reserve means it will not sell there. A realistic hammer for an accident-history S with no engine due diligence sits below fair value, which offsets the risk only partly. Known work is small.

mission_fit.rationale: The profile says a 3.4 Cayman S is bought only with unusually strong engine due diligence, and none exists here. The 2014 collision without repair docs also weakens the keeper case. The manual and low miles fit the brief.

logistics.rationale: The car is in Pennsylvania, far from Carmel. The seller offers a PPI at any nearby Porsche shop, but the auction ends 2026-10-28 12:48 PM PDT, leaving very little time to arrange it before a binding bid. CA smog and registration still need confirming.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: This is a 3.4 S with a 6-speed manual, Preferred Package Plus and an unmodified car. Arctic Silver over black is the most common colour combination, and the accident history detracts from originality.

evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper, a 3.4 Cayman S needs exceptional engine due diligence and clean history. This car currently has neither a borescope nor accident repair records, and the one-day auction window makes both hard to obtain.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-confirmed 2008 Cayman S with a 6-speed manual, 46,500 consistent miles, a clean PA title, and attached Carfax and AutoCheck reports. The Carfax records an October 2014 collision with moderate damage to the front and left side, and the seller has no repair documentation. Maintenance evidence is limited to 2022-2023 oil, tire, battery and TPMS receipts. The seller says there are no records of cooling, clutch, plug or other major services, and the last recorded brake flush was in 2014. No borescope or DME over-rev report exists for this M97 3.4. Disclosed flaws (rain sensor, chips, bumperette dents, worn hood struts) are minor. The one photo shows a straight, clean car. The seller offers a PPI at any nearby shop, but the reserve auction closes 2026-10-28 at 12:48 PM PDT.
